test_exit_rule: test the EXIT rule in Boost.Build by writing jam files and verifying exit codes and stdout output
test_exit_with_message: test the EXIT rule with a custom message argument and verify it prints the message to stdout
test_exit_with_code: test the EXIT rule with an explicit exit code argument and verify the build system exits with that code
test_exit_case_variants: test the EXIT rule using all case variants EXIT, Exit, and exit to verify case-insensitive behavior
test_boostbuild_tester: test BoostBuild.Tester by writing jam files, running the build system, and cleaning up test artifacts
